about: R407C is a blend of R32, R125 and R134a and is a common replacement for R22 in air-conditioning systems. It is non-flammable and works at pressures close to R22.
R407C has temperature glide, so charge it as a liquid and use polyolester (POE) oil. Confirm compressor compatibility before changing refrigerant.

faq.question: Is R407C flammable?
faq.answer: R407C is classified as non-flammable, but it is stored under pressure and can displace oxygen in enclosed spaces. Handle it through a trained technician with proper gauges, recovery equipment and ventilation.
